text:
mira: Heads-up 1 - third-party CI published a file that includes a KMS-wrapped Vault blob (saw in the partner build logs). Header: `projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/thirdparty-kr/cryptoKeys/tp-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/2`. Likely `secret/thirdparty/integration` but check.

oscar: Link? Can you DM it to sec channel? If it's in public build logs treat as exfil.

mira: Sent privately. I also ran a quick IAM check: `thirdparty-ci-sa@partner.dev` has decrypt on tp-wrap via a grant from 2023.

neha: I'll query KMS audit logs for Decrypt calls around the build time. Also set a temporary alert for any Decrypts of `tp-wrap` by principals outside our org.

tim: For containment: 1) apply temporary deny for the thirdparty SA on `tp-wrap`; 2) snapshot KMS + Vault audit logs to the forensics dataset; 3) enumerate Vault entries under `secret/thirdparty` and collect metadata only.

sec-bot: INC-2026-2104 created: "Third-party CI logs contain KMS-wrapped Vault blob". Assigned to @mira. Priority P2.

oscar: Rotation plan (staging-first): create new key version v3, prefer server-side rewrap. If not available run ephemeral hardened VM decrypt+encrypt with cloud logging disabled and no persistent disk. Keep old version active for 10 minutes after rotation.

neha: I'll prepare a small script to list `vault kv list secret/thirdparty` and fetch metadata only. No decrypts.

mira: Looping legal and partnerships for vendor notification. Notifying partner privately that we'll revoke access temporarily. Will update thread with timeline. :white_check_mark:
